name: API Fetcher
description: Fetch text or JSON from one or more HTTP endpoints and emit the responses as a normalized document list.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Primary HTTP or HTTPS API endpoint to fetch.

parameters.name: request_urls
parameters.description: Optional JSON array of request URLs. When provided, calls are capped by max_calls.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Optional JSON object of request headers.

parameters.name: response_selector
parameters.description: Optional dotted selector for extracting a nested JSON field.

parameters.name: max_calls
parameters.description: Maximum number of HTTP calls to execute from the request list.

parameters.name: allow_concurrency
parameters.description: Allow concurrent requests when multiple request URLs are provided.
